subject: Sponsor lounge lead-capture: opt-in wording + CRM routing
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acme.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Sponsor lounge lead-capture requirements

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking this — Acme is sponsoring the VIP lounge at Summit West (Jan 25-27). Our events team is finalizing lead-capture flow and we want to confirm how Redwood can handle opt-in language and CRM mapping for badge scans + fallback iPad forms. High-level asks: 

- We need consent language that meets both EU and US marketing opt-in (we're primarily US but some EU attendees will register).
- Primary capture will be badge scanner (VenueScanner). If badge fails, staff will use a short iPad form. Both should map into our HubSpot instance and a shadow SFDC record for our sales team.
- Deduping: prefer email as primary key, phone as secondary. We also need a lead source = "Acme Sponsor Lounge" and campaign parameter.

Can you confirm what exact opt-in verbiage you will present on the scanner/form, and whether Redwood can push both objects (HubSpot contact + SFDC lead) with a single webhook event? Also attaching the lounge floorplan so you can see scanner locations.

Cheers,
Claire
Senior Events Manager
Acme Corp
[attachment: sponsor-lounge-floorplan.pdf]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@acme.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor lounge lead-capture requirements

Hi Claire — great to connect.

Summary answer up-front: yes, we can present the opt-in language on the scanner and iPad fallback, and we can post a single normalized payload that your integrations team can split into HubSpot contact creation and SFDC lead creation. I will coordinate mapping and confirm the exact copy for legal/marketing sign-off.

Quick clarifying Qs before I draft copy:
- Do you need the EU GDPR checkbox to be explicit ("I consent to marketing communications from Acme Corp") or will the general opt-in text with link to privacy policy suffice?
- For badge scan data, will VenueScanner provide email/phone by default, or do we need the iPad to collect email when it's missing?

I'll loop in our sales ops and field ops to lock down routing. Attaching an initial opt-in draft (v1) so legal has something to review.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
[attachment: consent-swipe-text-v1.docx]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Sponsor lounge lead-capture requirements — need CRM routing + dedupe plan

Team — forwarding Claire's note. TL;DR: Acme wants scanner + iPad fallback that writes to HubSpot and SFDC. Can Redwood push one normalized webhook so external system can create both records? If not, what's the cleanest approach?

Proposal (please comment inline):
1) Event flow: Badge scanner emits token -> Redwood runtime enriches with KV cache and does quick PII normalization -> payload includes: email, phone, first_name, last_name, badge_id, scanner_location, consent_given (true/false), consent_text_version, lead_source = "Acme Sponsor Lounge", campaign = "Summit West 2027".
2) Delivery: Single webhook to Acme ingestion endpoint (we'll provide example). Acme ingestion should map to HubSpot contact/update and then to SFDC via their existing integration. Alternatively, Redwood can write directly to both HubSpot and SFDC via integrations if they provide API keys (we prefer webhook approach).
3) Deduping rules: primary = email (if present), fallback = phone, then badge_id. Include "merge_hint" fields so downstream CRM can decide.

Questions for Sales Ops (Karthik): can you confirm HubSpot property names and whether we should populate a custom boolean property "redwood_event_consent" or use existing marketing consent fields? Also can we auto-tag Owner by region using the badge location?

Sofia

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acme.com>
Date: Mon, Dec 20, 2026 at 3:02 PM
Subject: Sponsor lounge lead-capture requirements
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>

(see original)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sponsor lounge lead-capture requirements — need CRM routing + dedupe plan

Thanks Sofia. Good outline. A few concrete items from Sales Ops / Integrations: 

- HubSpot property mapping (recommended):
  - email -> contact.email
  - phone -> contact.phone
  - first_name, last_name -> contact.firstname/lastname
  - lead_source -> contact.hs_analytics_source (or custom property "acme_event_source")
  - campaign -> contact.campaign (or set campaign via UTM on the fallback form)
  - consent_text_version -> contact.redwood_consent_version (custom)
  - redwood_event_consent (boolean) -> contact.marketing_opt_in (if Acme prefers existing field)

- For SFDC: create Lead with fields: Email, Phone, LastName, Company = "Acme Sponsor Lounge" (temp), LeadSource = "Acme Sponsor Lounge", Campaign = "Summit West 2027". If email exists in SFDC, merge to contact owner by existing rules.

- Delivery mode: webhook to Acme ingestion endpoint is best. We'll include an example JSON payload. If they want direct writes, we'd need HubSpot API keys and SFDC integration scope (not preferred for partner-managed pipeline).

- Dedupe logic: Redwood should include these keys in the payload: primary_key=email, secondary_key=phone, fallback_key=badge_id. Also include raw_payload.badge_scan_raw so we can replay records if needed.

- Owner assignment: we can add a "region_tag" based on scanner_location. Sales can then auto-assign owner via HubSpot workflows.

I attached a sample webhook schema and included a short snippet for ingestion mapping.

Karthik Iyer
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample-event-webhook-schema.json]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-22T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor lounge lead-capture requirements — plan and next steps

Hi Claire / Tom — thanks for the details. Confirmed plan below and next steps: 

1) Opt-in language (final):
"By providing your contact details you agree to be contacted by Acme Corp and their partners about products and event opportunities. You can unsubscribe at any time. See Acme's Privacy Policy: https://acme.com/privacy"
Notes: For EU attendees we will show an explicit checkbox that reads "I consent to receive marketing communications from Acme Corp"; for US attendees we will show the short copy above with link. Consent text version will be included in the payload (consent_text_version="v1-20261222").

2) Data flow: Badge scanner -> Redwood ingest -> normalizer -> single webhook to Acme ingestion endpoint. Payload will include email/phone/name/badge_id/scanner_location/consent_boolean/consent_text_version/lead_source/campaign/merge_hint. (See sample webhook schema link we shared.)

3) CRM mapping: Follow Karthik's recommended mapping. We'll populate contact.redwood_consent_version and contact.redwood_event_consent (boolean) so you can trigger HubSpot workflows for opt-in-based nurture.

4) Deduping: Primary=email, secondary=phone, fallback=badge_id. If email missing, the iPad fallback will require email before submit.

5) Ownership & routing: We'll add region_tag derived from scanner_location. Karthik to provide HubSpot property names for auto-assign; Vanessa to confirm which scanner locations need manual monitoring.

Next steps / timeline:
- Today: Acme to review opt-in copy (attached) and confirm EU checkbox requirement (Claire).
- 12/23: Karthik will share final HubSpot property names and HubSpot contact ingestion example payload.
- 1/10: Field ops dry run at venue with two scanner locations.
- 1/20: Go-live.

Claire — please confirm and sign the attached data-handling addendum if everything looks good (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/ABC123). Once you sign, we'll schedule the dry run.

Thanks all —
Sofia Ivanova
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
